reason: alga-2026-0002797: GET /api/v1/schedules documented the generic WorkV1ListQuery placeholders (page, limit, sort, order, fields, search, query), which listScheduleEntries() never read; the spec now documents the parsed filters (start_date, end_date, user_id). Clients sending the old params still get 200 (they were and remain ignored).

alga-2026-0002797: the route is now wired to the schedule-entry controller, so the documented route/controller mismatch it flagged is fixed.
